title: Three drafts
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Thursday. The refusal to PNCA, drafted. Three drafts in the display face, each shorter. The third is one line. The dog sleeps on the first two.

panels.composition: The bedroom. WOOD at the desk lettering a letter in the flyer's display face — too formal, too big. BARNABY on the bed.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man at a small desk lettering a letter in bold hand-drawn display capitals, a small dog on the bed

panels.composition: Draft one: a full page. Draft two: half. Balled. The dog lying on both.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up of two crumpled letters on a bed with a small dog lying on them

panels.composition: Draft three: one line, in the display face: 'Thank you. No. —A. Finch.' The gull under it.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, close-up of a single hand-lettered line on white paper with a tiny gull mark beneath
image.notes: Letter after: 'Thank you. No. —A. Finch.' The gull. The author's name in the character's hand (the second time; see dw_2011-08-09).

panels.composition: Wood folding it. Looking at the corkboard: the scholarship letter, the acceptance, both pinned. He pins the refusal beside them. Three envelopes. Nobody will see the third.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a young man pinning a folded letter to a corkboard beside two envelopes, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'Thank you. No.' Pinned beside what it refuses.
